intent: Every compute engine may read any warehouse key under data/. It may ADD an input. It may never DELETE a warehouse object, drop a registered input, or shrink a series without an explicit Khalid consent note in this file.

rules.read: Engines read S3 warehouse only (data/, data/warm/, data/hot). No vendor HTTP from a brief compiler or fusion projection.
rules.choose: An engine picks which keys it needs. Fusion only sees registered legs. Missing data is a missing vote, never a fabricated 0.0.
rules.add: Adding a key is allowed: append to the engine's inputs[] and to engine-registry.v1.json (all three copies). Do not remove another key to make room.
rules.delete_forbidden: No s3.delete_object on data/ from an engine. No inputs[] removal. No dropping a brief field. Quarantine is named-fail, not delete.
rules.improve: Accuracy changes are additive: new adapter, new field, new trust weight. Shadow stays on until Khalid flips it. AI / page-brain may propose an added input; it may not ship a delete.
rules.consent: The only delete path is a signed row in consent_deletes[] below with slug, key, reason, date. Empty list means nothing may be deleted.
